stem.text: A stationary particle is in an electric field.
The only force on the particle is that from the electric field.
In which case is the electric field strength $5.0 \times 10^{5}\,\text{V m}^{-1}$?

A.text: a force of $1.6 \times 10^{-14}\,\text{N}$ acting on an electron

B.text: a force of $3.2 \times 10^{-14}\,\text{N}$ acting on an alpha-particle

C.text: a force of $8.0 \times 10^{-14}\,\text{N}$ acting on an alpha-particle

D.text: a force of $8.0 \times 10^{-14}\,\text{N}$ acting on a proton
